what: flag for out/running_example.json (that file is not changed): the edit of the example's complaint and the why-not rephrase belong to two different edits

complaint_edit.chosen_by: largest normalised coordinate over all positions (the default calibrated method releases no edit on the complaint)
complaint_edit.question: Who is the actor featured in this image?

whynot_edit.question: What is the title of the movie in this picture?
whynot_edit.rephrase: Which film does this scene belong to?

stream_position: index of the edit in the edit stream of the log (0 = the first edit)
for_the_text: present them as two edits: the complaint is attributed to the edit with the largest coordinate (the default method releases no edit on the complaint); the why-not question is asked about another edit of the same log
